_about: Generic OOK/ASK decoder: channel filter -> magnitude -> pulse decoder that measures pulse/gap widths, guesses PWM / PPM / Manchester and prints the bits of each transmission (like rtl_433's analyzer). For key fobs, doorbells, weather and tire sensors, garage remotes (only your own devices).
use_when: an on/off keyed burst signal (analyze_signal says OOK/ASK), usually 315 / 433.92 / 868 MHz

variables_help.chan_freq: absolute centre frequency of the signal in Hz
variables_help.chan_bw: channel filter width in Hz (100-300 kHz suits most OOK devices)
variables_help.decim: decimation to ~250 kS/s for the pulse decoder

spec.name: ook_burst_decoder
spec.title: OOK burst decoder
spec.description: xlating filter -> magnitude -> OOK pulse decoder
